title: GlobeBench: Evaluating Text-Based World Model Capabilities for Scalable Environment Simulations
abstract: arXiv:2610.22708v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text-based world models have recently shown potential to simulate complex RL environment state transitions for a diverse set of use cases. However, no standardized benchmark exists to compare, study and improve these models. Through this paper, we attempt to solve this problem by building GlobeBench, a novel benchmark with 1,632 tasks across five separate domains and nineteen simulation skills. The tasks check whether models can predict the environment's response to a specific action given the full agent trajectory by understanding earlier state changes, following environment rules, and predicting the effects of actions on both related and unrelated objects. We compare the predicted environment response with an execution-derived reference, using a hybrid architecture with both deterministic gates and a semantic judge. Among 20 general-purpose LLMs and specialized text world models, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest task success rate at 49

translated_title: GlobeBench：评估基于文本的世界模型在可扩展环境模拟中的能力
translated_abstract: 基于文本的世界模型最近展现出为多种用例模拟复杂强化学习（RL）环境状态转移的潜力。然而，目前尚无标准化基准来比较、研究和改进这些模型。本文试图通过构建 GlobeBench 来解决这一问题，这是一个新颖的基准，包含跨五个独立领域和十九项模拟技能的 1,632 个任务。这些任务通过理解先前的状态变化、遵循环境规则以及预测动作对相关和无关对象的影响，来检验模型在给定完整智能体轨迹的情况下能否预测环境对特定动作的响应。我们将预测的环境响应与通过执行得到的参考结果进行比较，采用结合了确定性门控和语义裁判的混合评估架构。在 20 个通用大语言模型和专用文本世界模型中，GPT-6 Astra 取得了最高的任务成功率，达到 49（%）（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: GlobeBench 是首个用于评估基于文本的世界模型能力的标准化基准，包含跨五个领域和十九项模拟技能的 1,632 个任务，并采用确定性门控与语义裁判相结合的混合评估架构。
en_tdlr: GlobeBench is the first standardized benchmark for evaluating text-based world model capabilities, featuring 1,632 tasks across five domains and nineteen simulation skills, with a hybrid evaluation architecture combining deterministic gates and a semantic judge.
